Fonepay Information Security Policy
By using fonepay, you confirm that you are in agreement with and bound by the Privacy Policy.
We at Fonepay Payment Services Limited are committed to assure our customers, merchants, business partners, and Financial Institutions and other stake holders for the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of the information as per the framework of the Information Security Management System.
To meet this commitment, we will:
Maintain an effective Information Security Management System.
Deploy most appropriate technology and infrastructure.
Meet all the contractual obligations on information security.
Meet all the regulatory and legislation requirements.
Create and maintain a security conscious culture within Information Services; and
Continually monitor and improve the effectiveness of the Information Security Management System.
